name: Microsoft 365 Administration
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate (SC-401)
tools: Microsoft 365 E5 developer or trial tenant

beginner.summary: For IT support staff and new administrators. Covers the Microsoft 365 tenant, admin centers and roles, domains, users and groups, licences, Entra ID basics, MFA and self-service password reset, Exchange Online mailboxes and mail flow, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint basics, Microsoft 365 Apps deployment, Intune device enrolment, Defender basics, Purview basics, service health, reports and PowerShell.
prerequisites: Supports users on Windows and Office applications
Knows basic networking such as DNS
outcomes: Set up and manage a Microsoft 365 tenant, domains, users, groups and licences
Secure sign-in with MFA and basic policies
Administer Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive and devices with Intune
Monitor the service and automate tasks with PowerShell

subtopics: Getting a developer or trial tenant
Other admin centers: Entra, Exchange, Teams, Intune and Purview
The course case company: a 500-person consultancy
days.lab_task: Create a trial tenant, set the organisation profile and release preferences, open each admin center and record what it is used for.
days.deliverable: Tenant settings screenshots and an admin center map
checks: Targeted release for a pilot group
Two upcoming changes noted with impact

subtopics: Global administrator and why to limit it
Role groups in Exchange and Purview
days.lab_task: Assign helpdesk, user and Exchange admin roles instead of global admin, create two emergency access accounts and review who holds privileged roles.
days.deliverable: Role assignments and review report
checks: Reset a password as a helpdesk admin
Change tenant settings as a helpdesk admin
No more than the agreed number

days.lab_task: Add a custom domain, verify it, create the required DNS records, set it as default and check mail records with an online tool.
days.deliverable: DNS records and verification screenshots

subtopics: Creating users one at a time and in bulk
Microsoft 365 groups, security groups and distribution lists
days.lab_task: Import 50 users from CSV, create department groups with dynamic membership, assign licences through groups and restore a deleted user.
days.deliverable: Users, groups and licence report

days.topic: Microsoft Entra ID for Microsoft 365 Administrators
subtopics: Microsoft Entra Connect and Cloud Sync in brief
days.lab_task: Brand the sign-in page, read sign-in and audit logs for a failed login, add an enterprise application and let users manage their own groups.
days.deliverable: Configuration and log findings
checks: Sign in with a wrong password
Failure in sign-in logs with reason

days.topic: MFA, Self-Service Password Reset and Security Defaults
subtopics: Per-user MFA compared with Conditional Access
days.lab_task: Turn on MFA for all users, set authentication methods with Authenticator and passkeys, enable self-service password reset and test both as a user.
days.deliverable: Settings and test results
checks: Reset done without the help desk

subtopics: Mailbox types: user, shared and resource
Mailbox permissions: full access, send as and send on behalf
days.lab_task: Create a shared mailbox for support with permissions, a meeting room with booking rules, add aliases and turn on an archive for a user.
days.deliverable: Mailbox configuration and tests
checks: Message sent from the shared address

subtopics: How mail flows in Exchange Online
days.lab_task: Add a disclaimer rule, block an attachment type, trace a message that did not arrive and release a message from quarantine.
days.deliverable: Rules, trace results and notes

subtopics: Teams architecture: teams, channels and chats
Teams policies: messaging, meetings and apps
days.lab_task: Create teams from a template, set meeting and messaging policies for staff and contractors, allow guest access and block external chat with one domain.
days.deliverable: Policies, teams and test results

days.lab_task: Set tenant sharing levels, redirect users' Documents and Desktop to OneDrive with Known Folder Move, restrict external sharing and restore a deleted file.
days.deliverable: Sharing settings and test results
checks: File back from the recycle bin

days.lab_task: Build a configuration with the Office Deployment Tool, deploy Microsoft 365 Apps through Intune on the Monthly Enterprise channel and fix an activation problem.
days.deliverable: Configuration file, deployment and fix notes

days.topic: Enrolling and Managing Devices with Intune
subtopics: Enrolment methods for Windows, iOS and Android
Remote actions: wipe, retire and restart
days.lab_task: Enrol a Windows device and a phone, apply a compliance policy and a configuration profile, deploy an app and retire a lost device.
days.deliverable: Policies, device records and test results

days.topic: Protecting Email with Microsoft Defender for Office 365
days.lab_task: Turn on preset security policies, configure Safe Links and Safe Attachments, run an attack simulation and review reported messages.
days.deliverable: Policies, simulation results and review notes

days.topic: Retention and Sensitivity Labels with Microsoft Purview
days.lab_task: Retain email for seven years, publish a confidential sensitivity label that encrypts documents, apply it as a user and find who opened a file with audit search.
days.deliverable: Policies, labels and audit results

days.topic: Service Health, Message Center and Support
days.lab_task: Review current incidents and advisories, write a user notice for one, run a network connectivity test and open a test support request.
days.deliverable: Incident summary, user notice and test results

days.lab_task: Find inactive licensed users, report Teams and OneDrive use by department, review Adoption Score and recommend licence changes.
days.deliverable: Usage report and licence recommendation
checks: Licensed users inactive for 90 days listed

days.topic: PowerShell and Microsoft Graph for Administration
days.lab_task: Connect to Graph and Exchange Online with limited scopes, bulk-update user departments from CSV, report mailbox sizes and export licence assignments.
days.deliverable: Scripts and outputs

subtopics: Licences, groups and mailboxes for new staff
days.lab_task: Onboard a new hire with groups, licences, mailbox and device, then offboard a leaver: block sign-in, convert the mailbox, hand over OneDrive and wipe the device.
days.deliverable: Checklists and completed records
checks: Manager has access to the files

days.topic: Backup, Retention and Recovery in Microsoft 365
days.lab_task: Back up mailboxes and OneDrive with Microsoft 365 Backup, restore a mailbox and a OneDrive to an earlier point and place a user on litigation hold.
days.deliverable: Backup configuration, restore evidence and hold settings
checks: Restore OneDrive to a point in time
Deleted items kept for the hold

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Setting Up a Microsoft 365 Tenant for a Company
days.lab_task: Set up the tenant for the case company: domain, users and groups from CSV, MFA, admin roles, shared mailboxes, Teams policies, sharing settings, Intune enrolment, preset security, a retention policy and an onboarding script, then hand it over with a runbook.
days.deliverable: Configured tenant, scripts and runbook
checks: Ready to work with mail, Teams and a managed device
MFA enforced and phishing protection active
A colleague can offboard a user using it
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one tenant
Set up Microsoft 365 for a company

intermediate.summary: For Microsoft 365 administrators. Covers hybrid identity, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, identity protection, Exchange hybrid and migrations, mail security with DKIM and DMARC, advanced Teams and Teams Phone, SharePoint administration, Intune in depth with Autopilot and app protection, Endpoint security, Defender XDR, Purview DLP, information protection, eDiscovery, insider risk, Copilot readiness, migrations from other platforms and the MS-102 exam.
prerequisites: Manages users, groups, licences, Exchange Online, Teams and Intune basics
outcomes: Secure identities with hybrid sync, Conditional Access and PIM
Run Exchange, Teams, SharePoint and devices at company scale
Protect data with Defender, DLP, labels and eDiscovery
Migrate workloads and pass the MS-102 exam

days.topic: Hybrid Identity with Entra Connect and Cloud Sync
subtopics: Entra Connect and Cloud Sync compared
Password hash sync, pass-through authentication and federation
tools: Microsoft Entra Connect or Cloud Sync
days.lab_task: Sync an Active Directory OU to Entra ID with password hash sync, filter what syncs, fix a duplicate attribute error and monitor sync health.
days.deliverable: Sync configuration and troubleshooting notes
checks: Sign in with the AD password

days.lab_task: Build policies that require MFA for all, compliant devices for admins, block legacy authentication and restrict access from outside India, testing each in report-only mode first.
days.deliverable: Policies and test results
checks: Sign in from an unmanaged device as an admin
Access blocked by the compliant device policy

days.topic: Privileged Identity Management and Access Reviews
days.lab_task: Make admin roles eligible with approval and time limits, activate a role with justification, run an access review of a sensitive group and create an access package for contractors.
days.deliverable: PIM settings, activation record and review results

days.lab_task: Require password change for high user risk and MFA for medium sign-in risk, investigate a simulated risky sign-in and remediate the account.
days.deliverable: Policies, investigation notes and remediation

subtopics: Migration options: cutover, staged, hybrid and IMAP
days.lab_task: Plan a hybrid migration, move a batch of mailboxes, check free and busy between on-premises and cloud users and fix a stalled move.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, batch report and fix notes

days.topic: Mail Security: SPF, DKIM, DMARC and Advanced Protection
days.lab_task: Turn on DKIM, publish DMARC at none, read aggregate reports, fix unauthorised senders and move the policy to quarantine then reject.
days.deliverable: DNS records, report analysis and policy change log

days.topic: Advanced Teams: Governance, Lifecycle and Teams Phone
subtopics: Teams Phone with calling plans or direct routing
days.lab_task: Limit who can create teams, apply naming and expiration policies, label confidential teams, set up an auto attendant and call queue and archive an old team.
days.deliverable: Governance settings, phone set-up and test results
checks: Create a team as a normal user
Guest access blocked for the team

subtopics: Site types: team and communication sites
days.lab_task: Create a hub with associated sites, set permissions and versioning, restrict a confidential site to a group and migrate a file share with the Migration Tool.
days.deliverable: Site structure, settings and migration report
checks: Others cannot open it even with a link

days.topic: Intune in Depth: Autopilot, Compliance and Configuration
subtopics: Windows Update rings and feature updates
days.lab_task: Provision a Windows device with Autopilot, enforce compliance with grace periods, configure settings with the settings catalog, set update rings and fix a problem with a remediation script.
days.deliverable: Profiles, policies and device reports
checks: Device ready with apps and policies

days.lab_task: Protect Outlook and Teams data on personal phones with app protection policies, require approved apps with Conditional Access and selectively wipe company data.
days.deliverable: Policies and test results
checks: Copy data to a personal app
Company data removed and personal data kept

days.topic: Endpoint Security with Intune and Defender for Endpoint
days.lab_task: Apply security baselines, BitLocker and LAPS, turn on attack surface reduction rules in audit then block mode and use device risk from Defender in compliance.
days.deliverable: Policies and test results
checks: Recovery key stored in Entra ID

days.lab_task: Investigate a simulated phishing incident across email, identity and endpoint, use advanced hunting to find affected users and let automated investigation remediate.
days.deliverable: Incident investigation and hunting queries
checks: Users who clicked the link listed

days.topic: Data Loss Prevention with Microsoft Purview
subtopics: DLP policies for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams
days.lab_task: Create a DLP policy for Aadhaar and card numbers across email, Teams and devices, run it in simulation, tune false positives and enforce with policy tips.
days.deliverable: DLP policy, simulation results and tuning notes

subtopics: Labels for sites, groups and Teams
Labels in Office, PDF and other files
days.lab_task: Design a four-level label scheme, require labels in Office apps, auto-label documents with card numbers and review label activity.
days.deliverable: Label scheme, policies and activity report
checks: Save a document without a label

days.lab_task: Open an eDiscovery case, place custodians on hold, search mail and Teams for a project name, review results and export them for legal.
days.deliverable: Case, holds, search results and export

days.lab_task: Create an insider risk policy for departing employees, simulate a data theft, review the alert with pseudonymised names and create a communication compliance policy for offensive language.
days.deliverable: Policies, alert review and notes

days.topic: Preparing a Tenant for Microsoft 365 Copilot
days.lab_task: Find overshared sites with data access governance reports, fix permissions on three, restrict search for sensitive sites, run a Copilot pilot and review usage.
days.deliverable: Oversharing report, fixes and pilot results

days.topic: Migrating to Microsoft 365 from Google Workspace and Other Platforms
days.lab_task: Migrate a pilot group from Google Workspace: mail, calendar and Drive, cut over MX records and run post-migration checks.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, migration reports and checklist
checks: New mail arrives in Exchange Online

days.lab_task: Take a timed practice assessment, repeat failed tasks in the tenant, review Microsoft Learn modules for weak areas and take a second practice assessment.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list
checks: Each done correctly in the tenant

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Secure and Compliant Microsoft 365 for a Regulated Company
days.lab_task: Secure the tenant for a regulated company: hybrid identity, Conditional Access and PIM, Autopilot and endpoint security, DMARC at reject, DLP and labels, eDiscovery and Copilot readiness, then demo responses to a phishing attack and a data leak.
days.deliverable: Configuration documentation, policies and demo recording
checks: DLP stops the leak and alerts
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one tenant

advanced.summary: For senior Microsoft 365 administrators and architects. Covers tenant architecture and multi-geo, cross-tenant collaboration and migrations, zero trust design, advanced Conditional Access, workload identities, automation with Graph and Azure Automation, infrastructure as code for Microsoft 365, Defender XDR at scale, Sentinel integration, data governance at scale, records management, compliance for regulators, Copilot and agent governance, Teams voice at scale, change and release management, cost and licensing, incident response and tenant health.
prerequisites: Administers Microsoft 365 security and compliance at company scale
Has run migrations or major tenant changes
outcomes: Design tenants and collaboration across organisations and regions
Apply zero trust and automation to identity and devices
Govern data, records, Copilot and compliance at scale
Lead incident response, change and licensing decisions

days.topic: Tenant Architecture, Multi-Geo and Data Residency
days.lab_task: Design the tenant strategy for a group with companies in India, the EU and the US, decide on Multi-Geo, set preferred data locations and record the decisions.
days.deliverable: Tenant design and decision records
checks: Choice justified with legal and operational reasons
Users' content stored in the right geo

subtopics: Entra B2B and cross-tenant access settings
B2B direct connect and Teams shared channels
days.lab_task: Set up a multitenant organisation for two companies, share Teams channels across tenants, sync users across tenants and migrate a pilot mailbox and OneDrive between tenants.
days.deliverable: Configuration, shared channel tests and migration report
checks: Join a shared channel from the other tenant
Users from tenant A appear in tenant B
Mailbox and files in the new tenant

subtopics: Identity, device, app and data pillars
days.lab_task: Assess the tenant's zero trust maturity, design a phased policy set across identity, devices and data and present the roadmap.
days.deliverable: Assessment, policy design and roadmap

days.topic: Advanced Conditional Access and Authentication Strength
subtopics: Token protection and continuous access evaluation
Session controls with Defender for Cloud Apps
days.lab_task: Rebuild policies by persona, require phishing-resistant MFA for admins, apply session controls for unmanaged devices, back up policies as code and analyse impact with workbooks.
days.deliverable: Persona policy set, backups and impact analysis
checks: Sign in as an admin with SMS

days.lab_task: Review all app registrations, remove over-privileged permissions, turn on the admin consent workflow, protect workload identities with Conditional Access and remove unused apps.
days.deliverable: App review, changes and policies

days.topic: Automating Microsoft 365 with Graph, Azure Automation and Logic Apps
subtopics: Logic Apps and Power Automate for admin tasks
days.lab_task: Automate joiners and leavers with lifecycle workflows, build a runbook that reports licence waste weekly using a certificate and a Logic App that posts service health to Teams.
days.deliverable: Workflows, runbook and Logic App
checks: Add a joiner in HR data
Workflow creates access on the start date

days.lab_task: Export the tenant's configuration with Microsoft365DSC, store it in Git, detect drift after a manual change and deploy a policy set to a test tenant through a pipeline.
days.deliverable: Exported configuration, drift report and pipeline

days.lab_task: Write custom detections for business email compromise and suspicious inbox rules, tune automated investigation, run a threat analytics review and report response metrics.
days.deliverable: Detections, tuning notes and metrics report
checks: Fewer manual approvals for safe actions
Time to detect and respond measured

days.lab_task: Connect Microsoft 365 and Entra logs to Sentinel, write an analytics rule for impossible travel, build a playbook that disables an account and estimate ingestion cost.
days.deliverable: Connectors, rule, playbook and cost estimate

days.topic: Data Governance at Scale with Purview
days.lab_task: Run data access governance reports, set inactive site policies, launch site owner access reviews and report labelling coverage to leadership.
days.deliverable: Governance policies, review results and report
checks: Owners asked to confirm or archive

days.topic: Records Management and Retention at Scale
subtopics: Retention for Teams and Copilot interactions
days.lab_task: Build a file plan, apply event-based retention for contracts, run a disposition review and use adaptive scopes for retention by department.
days.deliverable: File plan, labels and disposition evidence
checks: Retention starts from the event date

days.topic: Compliance for Regulators: Compliance Manager and Audits
subtopics: Assessments for ISO 27001, DPDP and others
days.lab_task: Run Compliance Manager assessments for ISO 27001 and the DPDP Act, complete five improvement actions with evidence and prepare an auditor pack.
days.deliverable: Assessments, completed actions and auditor pack
checks: Retention policy set for the required period

subtopics: Data protection for prompts and responses
days.lab_task: Set Copilot and agent governance for the tenant, restrict agent creation, audit Copilot interactions with Purview, write the AI use policy and measure value for a pilot group.
days.deliverable: Governance settings, audit results, policy and value report
checks: Create an agent as a normal user
Prompts and responses found in audit

days.topic: Teams Voice and Meetings at Scale
subtopics: Call quality and the Call Quality Dashboard
Large meetings, webinars and town halls
days.lab_task: Design voice for three offices, configure emergency locations, analyse call quality, fix a network problem causing poor calls and plan a town hall.
days.deliverable: Voice design, call quality analysis and town hall plan
checks: Poor calls traced to a site network
Format and capacity suit the audience

days.lab_task: Set up message center triage with owners, create pilot rings, control a new feature with policy, communicate it and measure adoption.
days.deliverable: Triage process, rings and adoption report
checks: Available only to the pilot ring

subtopics: Add-ons: E5 security, compliance and Copilot
days.lab_task: Analyse licence use, find waste and over-licensing, model moving users between suites and estimate annual savings for renewal.
days.deliverable: Licence analysis and savings model

days.lab_task: Respond to a simulated business email compromise with token theft and a malicious app: investigate, contain, collect evidence, recover and write the review.
days.deliverable: Investigation log, containment steps and review
checks: Timeline, cause and hardening actions recorded

subtopics: Secure Score and identity score tracking
Service levels for the help desk
days.lab_task: Build a monthly tenant health dashboard covering service incidents, drift, Secure Score, licence use and help desk volumes, and run a review meeting.
days.deliverable: Dashboard and review minutes

subtopics: Sync problems with OneDrive and Entra
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected issues (a Conditional Access lockout, a mail loop, an Entra sync failure, an Intune policy conflict and poor Teams calls), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Users sign in and the policy is corrected

days.lab_task: Design and deliver Microsoft 365 for a multinational group: tenant and data residency strategy, cross-tenant collaboration, zero trust policies as code, automated lifecycle, Defender and Sentinel response, records and Copilot governance and a licensing plan, then run an incident drill and present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, configuration repository, drill report and board presentation
checks: Deploy a policy change through the pipeline
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one design
